utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you mean the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off tools and supplies over by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, over by the community hall? Just making sure that's the repair drive everyone’s talking about.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the one by the community hall. Folks have been bringing in tools and supplies all morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. Tell me where you need me to be.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I’m a bit mixed up, but I think you can just meet me by the driveway around noon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, I’ll meet you by the driveway around noon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that. What’s the main thing you need fixed on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the dryer on the repair drive, and a couple of loose cabinet doors if you have time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do the dryer first, then check the cabinet doors if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that drive. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly the wiring and the power coupler. If you can check the connectors, I can handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it. I’ll check the connectors and let you handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup, but I need to check my schedule first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye. I’ll check back after pickup and line up the repair drive details then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Jules. I’ll confirm after pickup and we can line up the repair drive then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We should keep it simple: tell me the day and the list, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple is good. I’ll bring the day and the list over once I find my notes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Just bring me the day and the list, and I’ll keep my schedule open.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, Pia. Count me in for the repair drive, and I’ll make sure a few more neighbors hear about it too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. Just keep me posted on who’s coming so I can sort the supplies and timing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll keep you posted as folks sign on and what they might need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I only got that secondhand. Is it still happening?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s still happening. I’m organizing the list today, so if you need anything fixed, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll send you the details if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you walk me through what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, I can go over it: the main things are the loose front gate, the broken porch step, and the flickering hallway light. I’ll write down anything else we notice so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll keep those three in mind and watch for anything else you notice.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that, but I need to hear what Dane said first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I said I could help with the repair drive, but I joined late and missed the details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just tell me what time and place the drive needs, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Mina. I can bring over a drill and a wrench set if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about 10 in the morning?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the repair drive location now if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, check it and let me know where it is.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check and tell you where it is.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey — I’ve got a couple of tools I can lend you for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make good use of them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Rey. Let me know if you need anything else for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit wary of the timing. Do we know who’s handling the parts and where everyone’s supposed to drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can we get a straight answer on that before anything gets dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, we need a clear drop-off point and one person coordinating the parts before anybody moves.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can help with that drive. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll list the remaining fixes and start asking around for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks. I’ll check in once I’ve got a list together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the tarps and extra tape from my shed if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in. I can help haul what’s left and get there as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then I’ll load up the tarps and tape and meet you there as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up this week, so I’m keeping an ear out for what they still need. I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I appreciate it. I’m trying to keep up with the school schedule, so any updates on what they need would help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll see what I can find out, and if I hear the school needs anything specific, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo. Can you take the lead on the repair list, and I’ll coordinate the volunteers and supplies?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely — I’ll take the lead on the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with that. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I need a quick fix on the back gate latch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take a look at it. Is the latch loose or just not catching properly?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone about it, and I can swing by with details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d help. I’d like the details if you’re swinging by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll swing by with the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check where the repair drive is being handled. Which location are you starting from?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m starting from the east side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. I’m heading from the east side entrance now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing, and when do you want it done?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s the living room outlet and the back gate, and I’d like it done this Saturday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday works for me. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up, and I can swing by after errands if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that'd be a big help, Ira. I might already have the wrong end of the screwdriver, so come by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll be there after I finish these errands. Try not to wrestle the screwdriver too hard before then.
